title: My notes
placeholder: Write down your ideas during the meeting…
guestNotice: Temporary notes — copy them before leaving. To find your notes after meetings, take them while signed in.
saveError: Notes not saved. Your draft is kept here.
loadError: Unable to load notes. Try again.
accessError: Unable to access notes. Check your session and access permissions, then try again.
accessErrorWithDraft: Unable to access notes. Your draft is kept here. Check your session and access permissions, then try again.
conflict: Another version was saved. Your draft is kept here.
confirmOverwrite: Replace the saved version with your draft?
limitReached: Edit rejected: it exceeds the 100,000-character limit. Your previous text is preserved.

enrichment.title: Add to my notes
enrichment.help: Suggest additions from the transcript. Your notes stay private. Nothing is added without your approval.
enrichment.generating: Preparing additions… You can keep writing in your notes.
enrichment.discarding: Checking cancellation… Your notes remain editable.
enrichment.applying: Saving additions… Your notes remain readable and can be copied.
enrichment.review: Only this text will be appended under “Compléments de la réunion”. Your existing notes will be preserved exactly.
enrichment.modified: Proposal edited by you. The excerpts support the initial proposal and do not certify your edits.
enrichment.invalidAdditions: Enter non-empty additions with valid characters, up to 8,000 characters.
enrichment.undoUnavailable: Your notes have changed since this addition; automatic undo is no longer available.
enrichment.retryMutationHelp: The server has not confirmed the operation yet. You can resend the exact same request without adding the additions twice. Your notes remain readable and copyable while checking.
enrichment.undone: Last enrichment undone and notes saved.
enrichment.cancelled: Proposal discarded. Your notes are preserved.
enrichment.proposalRemoved: This proposal is no longer current. Your notes are preserved and any new proposal remains available.
enrichment.proposalAppliedElsewhere: This proposal was applied in another tab. Review the saved version of your notes; your local typing is preserved.
enrichment.stale: Your notes or the transcript have changed. Generate a new proposal using the latest version.
enrichment.empty: No additions proposed from the passages analysed.
enrichment.failed: Unable to prepare additions. Your notes are preserved.
enrichment.unknown: The generation outcome is uncertain. Check its status before trying again.
enrichment.selectedPassages: Additions use selected passages; coverage is not exhaustive.

reasons.empty_note: Write and save some notes before requesting additions.
reasons.meeting_active: Additions are available after the meeting ends.
reasons.sources_unavailable: The transcript is not yet available to enrich your notes.
reasons.note_changed: Your notes have changed. Check that they are saved before trying again.
reasons.input_too_large: These notes exceed the analysis capacity. Their full text is preserved.
reasons.operation_in_progress: An operation is already in progress. Check its status before trying again.

errors.load: Unable to check whether additions are available. Your notes are preserved.
errors.generate: The request could not be confirmed. Check its status before trying again; your notes are preserved.
errors.discard: Cancellation not confirmed. Your notes are preserved. Check the status or retry cancellation.
errors.mutation: The change was not confirmed. Your current notes have been reloaded; review them before trying again.

exit.title: Your notes have not been saved
exit.body: Your latest changes have not been saved. Retry or resolve the conflict in My notes before leaving. Leaving without saving will lose these changes.
